snippet.title: PowerWash Simulator 2 | Barbie Pack Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Get ready to making everything sparkle as we take Barbie on a whole new cleaning adventure!

The Barbie Pack will be splashing its way into PowerWash Simulator 2 December 3rd on PC, Xbox Series X|S, PlayStation 5 and Nintendo Switch 2

PowerWash Simulator 2 is available now! https://www.bit.ly/PWS2Steam

For more pressure washing goodness, subscribe to our channel! ⤵️
Follow our Twitter for daily satisfying content: https://bit.ly/TwitterPWS
Join the conversation on our Discord: https://discord.gg/powerwashsimulator
